summary: Seven distinct Columbus industrial refinance opportunities qualify with confirmed active debt, executed-note maturities between 2026-09-01 and 2027-08-31, verified record owners, and current qualifying finance contacts. Ranked by maturity ascending then original principal descending: R2362, R4643, R3353, R3917, R2253, R5546, R7918. Total original principal $41.88M.
limitations: outstanding_balance_usd is null for every record; only original principal is available and the two are not interchangeable.
R2253 has no published contact email (email_basis: not_published); outreach requires alternate channel.
R4643 is eligible only because the recorded release (U-R4643-2) becomes effective 2026-09-10, after the 2026-08-31 cutoff; status is likely to change post-cutoff.
R3353 is retained on the base executed_note because U-R3353-3 is an unsigned draft; a subsequent execution would move the maturity to 2028-01-01 and disqualify it.
R3353 and R3917 tie on maturity (2027-04-15) and principal ($5.88M); ordering between them is arbitrary within the stated sort keys (broken by record_id ascending).
No CFO or Head of Acquisitions contacts appear in the packet; all shortlisted contacts are Directors of Finance.

Ownership and contact verification for shortlisted records all resolve to 2026-08-10, a single verification pass; no independent second-source confirmation beyond the base extract (aside from R2362/R7391 duplicate pair).
